title: A finite module over a Noetherian ring complete along an ideal is complete
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $J\subseteq R$ an ideal such that $R$ is $J$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $N$ be a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then $N$ is $J$-adically complete: the canonical $R$-linear map $N\to\varprojlim_nN/J^nN$, $x\mapsto(x\bmod J^nN)_n$, into the module of compatible sequences is bijective.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00MA (lemma-completion-tensor) (3): N^ = N (x)_R R^, applied with R -> R^ bijective; equivalently Lemma 031B (lemma-when-finite-module-complete-over-complete-ring) with the Krull intersection theorem (Lemma 00IP, lemma-intersect-powers-ideal-module-zero) for J in the Jacobson radical (Lemma 05GI)
